## Current Limitation

Describe the concrete maintenance or contributor problem. Include evidence such
as duplication, fragile tests, slow feedback, or recurring failures.

## Affected Area

- [ ] Developer experience
- [ ] Build or Nix environment
- [ ] CI or release infrastructure
- [ ] Architecture or refactor
- [ ] Dependencies
- [ ] Test infrastructure
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Desired Outcome

Describe the measurable improvement without requiring a particular technical
solution.

## Proposed Direction

If you have an implementation direction in mind, describe it here.

## Tradeoffs and Migration

Identify risks, compatibility constraints, migration work, or alternatives.

## Acceptance Criteria

How will maintainers verify that the improvement is complete?

## Checklist

- [ ] I searched the existing issues for related maintenance work.
- [ ] The issue describes the problem independently of the proposed solution.
